meta.title: ESISA Gaming Club
meta.description: The official ESISA esports and gaming club in Fez. Members, events, and community.

hero.tagline: Every match counts — every player matters.

about.label: About
about.lead: EGC is where skill meets passion.
about.p1: Born at the heart of ESISA, the club brings the school's players together through competition, mutual support and events. Beginner or tryhard, there's a place for you.
about.h2: Here, you don't just play — you improve.
about.p2: Every scrim is a step forward. Every tournament builds your story. Solo or with a team, EGC makes room to play seriously, in a healthy atmosphere.
about.closing: This is where ESISA players level up.

items.q: Do I need to be an ESISA student?
items.a: Yes, the club is for ESISA students. Some events are open to guests: we announce them on Discord.
Membership details are shared at the start of the season on Discord and at school.

items.q: I'm a beginner, can I join?
items.a: Of course. The club welcomes every level: we run sessions to improve together.
Valorant, League of Legends, EA Sports FC and Minecraft, plus others depending on what members want.

items.q: How do I enter a tournament?
items.a: Browse upcoming events and sign up on the event page when registration is open.

items.q: Can I suggest a game or an event?
items.a: Yes! Reach out to the committee on Discord with your idea.
